long_description:
Every AI today waits for a prompt. Vexo already has the context: the restaurant a friend mentioned, the intro you promised, the idea you had on a walk. It turns what it hears into private memories and acts on them, booking the table, sending the follow-up, and ordering the groceries through the apps you already use.

It's a woven bracelet with a microphone and health sensors. No screen, and nothing to open.

Vexo never keeps your audio. Only you can see your memories, and you can delete them anytime.
name: Vexo
one_liner: An AI bracelet that remembers your day and acts before you ask.
